# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We, as contributors and maintainers of projects under the Ministry of Health
and Child Care (MOHCC) Zimbabwe organization, pledge to make participation in
our projects and community a harassment-free experience for everyone,
regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and
expression, level of experience, nationality, personal appearance, race,
religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of behaviour that contributes to a positive environment:

- Using welcoming and inclusive language.
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences.
- Gracefully accepting constructive criticism.
- Focusing on what is best for the Ministry's mission and the public it serves.
- Showing empathy towards other community members.

Examples of unacceptable behaviour:

- The use of sexualized language or imagery, and unwelcome sexual attention.
- Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks.
- Public or private harassment.
- Publishing others' private information (such as patient data, personal
  contact details, or credentials) without explicit permission.
- Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a
  professional or public-service setting.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces under this
organization (issues, pull requests, discussions, commit messages) and in
public spaces when an individual is representing a project or the
organization.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behaviour may be
reported by contacting:

- **chihwayii@outlook.com** *(interim contact pending an official MOHCC ICT
  Directorate point of contact)*

All complaints will be reviewed and investigated and will result in a
response deemed necessary and appropriate to the circumstances. Project
maintainers are obligated to maintain confidentiality with regard to the
reporter of an incident.

Maintainers who do not follow or enforce this Code of Conduct in good faith
may face temporary or permanent repercussions as determined by the ICT
Directorate.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1.
